description: This file defines a date culture information object for Gujarati (India) locale, including date and time formats, localization strings, and date manipulation methods using the Datejs library.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object holding locale-specific date and time formatting and localized strings for Gujarati (India).

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.
